geometry.method: Tripo /mesh/decimate v1.0; no local geometry reduction or manual region protection
geometry.sample_limitations: World-space vertices and triangle centroids after uniform bbox alignment; source GLB units are not true pet measurements; not continuous Hausdorff distance or anatomical proof
geometry.final_asset_coordinate_policy: Retains provider coordinates. Uniform bbox transform is for comparison/render scenes only. Do not reuse prior face IDs, UV correspondence, skin weights or joint positions.

analysis_welded_topology.meaning: Analysis-copy topology; not anatomical or animation acceptance

geometry.visual_anatomy: Six full-body views inspected: four recognizable legs, two ears and separated raised tail; static visual review, not anatomy automation or deformation proof.

surface_sample_check.method: Three interior samples per reduced triangle; nearest source surface and barycentric UV interpolation. Decode sRGB, bilinear-sample linear RGB with repeat wrapping, then report sRGB channel error.
surface_sample_check.scope: Unweighted surface color-change diagnostic from generated source; not photo reconstruction accuracy, identity acceptance or exact renderer pixel matching. Nearest-surface correspondence may be ambiguous near seams and close surfaces.
surface_sample_check.trigger_status: Initial diagnostic thresholds, not calibrated product acceptance

surface_color.recovery_decision: Skip restoration: no lost material factors or resolution and no significant corresponding-surface color change under initial diagnostic thresholds. A changed encoded image hash alone does not establish visible loss; retaining the current texture avoids an unnecessary rebake.
surface_color.policy_clarification: Config bake_source_base_color_if_service_texture_changed is treated as a fidelity review trigger, not mandatory rebaking for any changed byte or UV. Original request/config is preserved unchanged.

identity.review_method: Manual comparison of six actual GLB renders with identity-source.png, real photo-03.png and the selected AI references.
